name: SFC Environmental Technologies Limited
summary: Wastewater and solid-waste treatment technology firm (C-Tech SBR process, over 80% SBR market share per F&S) with 728 installations.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹804 Cr (+15%), PAT about ₹160 Cr (flat vs FY25); Q1 FY27 revenue ₹134 Cr; net worth ₹825 Cr.
positives: Market leader in SBR sewage treatment technology
red_flags: Trade receivables ₹609 Cr (76% of FY26 revenue) and rising
Profit flat in FY26 despite 15% revenue growth
Only ₹150 Cr fresh; most of the issue is OFS by selling shareholders
anchor: Anchor bidding 26 Oct; not yet out
